## Summary

Describe the user-facing outcome and why the change is needed.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to one coherent outcome.
- [ ] Tests cover contract or validator behavior changes.
- [ ] Plugin and marketplace metadata remain aligned.
- [ ] Documentation and bundled assets are updated where needed.
- [ ] No credentials, private source material, generated project outputs, or personal data are included.
